title: Neeraj Chopra finishes 2nd in Lausanne Diamond League javelin event
content: Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage edged Neeraj Chopra by just nine centimetres to beat him for the third time this season at the Lausanne Diamond League. Chopra briefly led with an 88.05m second-round throw, but Pathirage responded with 88.14m. Chopra settled for silver, while Anderson Peters took third, with the result also boosting Chopra’s hopes of reaching the Diamond League Final.

title: FIFA bans Leandro Paredes for 10 matches over World Cup final scuffle
content: Argentina midfielder Leandro Paredes has been handed a 10-match ban by FIFA following a scuffle with Spain players moments after the World Cup final. Paredes received the longest suspension among three Argentina players punished for the incident. The sanctions were announced by FIFA on Friday.

title: Govt orders Google to shut down hundreds of Firebase accounts over scam misuse
content: Indian authorities ordered Google to close hundreds of Firebase accounts.  These accounts were exploited by criminals for banking scams and malware.  Officials found a pattern of impersonating major banks to defraud users.  The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre issued multiple notices for account removals.  This action is part of India's increased efforts against online financial fraud.

title: Zuckerberg buys Gothic castle in Ireland, Meta's international HQ, for $35 mn
content: Meta CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, and his wife, Priscilla Chan, have acquired the historic Strancally Castle, a stunning Gothic mansion set on an expansive estate in Ireland. This remarkable property will serve as their home base during visits to the nation, which is significant due to Meta's international headquarters being located there. The couple is excited about the opportunity to preserve and nurture this piece of history.

title: US seized California island ranch after $4m offer; jury awarded family $12.7m
content: A federal jury awarded a California family $12.7 million for their Santa Cruz Island ranch.  The government had seized the 6,300-acre property using eminent domain in 1996.  This verdict concluded a decades-long property dispute between park officials and the Gherini family.  The family's ancestors had owned part of the island since the late 19th century.  The award allowed the National Park Service to gain full control of the land.

title: In 2016, Burt's Bees co-founder gave US 87,500 acres; now it's a monument
content: Roxanne Quimby, the visionary behind Burt's Bees, initially embraced a life of artistic expression and sustainability before venturing into the business world. After partnering with Burt Shavitz, they created a beloved range of beeswax products. Motivated by her love for nature, Quimby invested her earnings into the conservation of Maine's forests, acquiring extensive land despite pushback from logging interests.

title: How Chile telescope accidentally captured a missing link in astronomy
content: An unfinished observatory in Chile has captured dense gas clouds from a dying star. These expelled clouds are now blending back into the Milky Way galaxy. This breakthrough demonstrates how stellar elements are recycled for future celestial bodies. The observatory, MOTHRA, achieved this during calibration tests in November 2025. The findings offer critical new insights into stellar mass loss interactions.

title: Bautista's Net Worth: Inside the Ex-WWE Star's $16M Hollywood Fortune
content: Dave Bautista transitioned from wrestling stardom to Hollywood success. His role as Drax in Marvel films significantly boosted his global recognition. Bautista's career includes acting, film projects, and endorsements. He also briefly competed in mixed martial arts before acting. His estimated net worth in 2026 is around sixteen million dollars.

title: Leon Draisaitl's wife Celeste Desjardins: Inside their life off the ice
content: Leon Draisaitl and Celeste Desjardins have gone from a private couple to one of the NHL's most recognizable pairs, and the Edmonton Oilers star and Canadian actress tied the knot in France in 2025 after years of dating. Their story includes Draisaitl’s elite NHL career, Desjardins’ acting, close friendships and a quieter life away from professional hockey.

title: Miz and Maryse's combined net worth in 2026: WWE fortune, real estate and more
content: Mike Mizanin and Maryse Ouellet boast a combined net worth of $14 million in 2026. Their WWE careers and reality television success significantly contribute to their wealth. Diversified income streams from acting and business ventures further bolster their financial standing. The couple's real estate investments and brand partnerships also add to their fortune. Their continued work in entertainment suggests potential for further wealth accumulation.

title: Jantar Mantar sees large anti-reservation protest despite Delhi Police warning
content: A large crowd gathered at Delhi's Jantar Mantar for a protest.  These protesters demanded changes to the existing caste-based reservation system.  Delhi Police had clearly stated that no permission was granted for this demonstration.  Security forces were deployed and barricades were installed as a precautionary measure.  Legal action was warned against those spreading false information about the protest.

title: Russia gives drones their own military branch as modern warfare enters a new era
content: In a significant development, Russia has established a new command for unmanned systems forces, appointing General Denis Lyamin as its leader. This initiative marks a pivotal transformation in Moscow's approach to modern warfare. Meanwhile, Ukraine has also unveiled its long-range impact command, highlighting the increasing reliance on drones in both nations' military strategies.

title: 'A border state': Akali leader fuels buzz over SAD-BJP reunion, gives this reason
content: Bikram Singh Majithia of the Shiromani Akali Dal expressed that public sentiment is leaning towards an alliance with the BJP. He highlighted Punjab's strategic location and the importance of social harmony as pivotal factors. The two parties had a longstanding relationship before parting ways over farm laws. Majithia emphasised that the final decision will come from the leadership of both sides, leaving the results of this potential collaboration uncertain.

title: FIH Women's Hockey World Cup: India go down 0-2 to Netherlands
content: The defeat leaves India with a tough task in their final second-round match. India will face Australia on Sunday and need a win to keep their hopes of reaching the semi-finals alive. Australia were held to a 1-1 draw by China in another second-round match earlier on Friday.

title: Congress’s renewed youth outreach: How CJP has forced parties to course correct
content: Student protests at Jantar Mantar have prompted political parties to rethink their youth engagement strategies. The Congress party is now focusing on youth issues and expanding its outreach programs nationwide. Rahul Gandhi's recent actions highlight the party's renewed commitment to addressing student concerns. The Congress Working Committee has proposed an education-to-employment roadmap for young people. This shift reflects a broader effort to regain support among the nation's youth.

title: Who pays what in a rental home? Property tax, maintenance and utility bills explained
content: In India, property taxes are fundamentally the responsibility of the property owner as per municipal regulations. Meanwhile, utility expenses for water and electricity are usually settled by the tenant who consumes these services. Maintenance fees of housing societies are generally charged to owners, but tenancy agreements can sometimes allocate part of these costs to renters. Clarifying these responsibilities helps avoid conflicts between landlords and tenants.

title: 'Main Mami Se Baat Karungi': Arti Singh on Govinda-Sunita Ahuja divorce buzz
content: Arti Singh recently spoke about the ongoing marital struggles between Govinda and Sunita Ahuja, emphasizing that family matters should remain private among relatives. She expressed disapproval of those who seek fame from such controversies. Notably, Sunita Ahuja's previous divorce filing was later retracted, further adding intrigue to their relationship, which has been under media scrutiny for a considerable time.

title: Govinda's manager denies second marriage claims made by Sunita Ahuja
content: Sunita Ahuja claimed Govinda planned a second marriage, which his manager strongly denied. Govinda's manager expressed shock and stated no second marriage is happening. He mentioned Sunita withdrew her divorce petition after making these claims. The manager urged Sunita to consider their children's well-being amidst the controversy. Govinda remains focused on his work and has not spoken against his wife.

title: SC closes 'The Kerala Story' petitions, says question of law will 'await another movie'
content: The Supreme Court disposed of petitions challenging CBFC's certification of "The Kerala Story," ruling them infructuous since the film had already released, while leaving the broader legal question on certification challenges open. Justice Bagchi said this would "await another movie." The court also declined immediate hate speech guidelines, suggesting a separate comprehensive petition instead.

title: Fury on Hyderabad street Aston Martin kills Odisha woman, family devastated 1,200km away
content: In a tragic incident, Bharati Mukhi lost her life after being struck by a speeding Aston Martin while crossing the street in Hyderabad. The driver, the son of a Janasena Party MP, is undergoing intoxication testing. Mukhi was the primary breadwinner for her family, who now faces significant financial challenges and seeks government aid. Authorities await forensic and post-mortem reports to continue their investigation.

title: Maharashtra teen jumps off cliff, parents fall to death trying to save him
content: A family of three tragically died after falling into a deep stone quarry on Friday. The incident occurred when parents attempted to save their son from a dangerous cliff edge. Police and fire brigade personnel were present and had been trying to persuade the youth for hours. The son suddenly fell, and his father tried to grab him, losing his own balance.

title: Lip plumpers, collagen & more: How Ozempic is boosting a new beauty market
content: Weight-loss drugs are creating new demands in beauty and nutrition sectors. Companies are developing products to address nutritional gaps and emerging beauty concerns. Nestle and Tata Consumer are preparing protein and fiber-rich offerings for these consumers. Beauty brands are promoting makeup alternatives to cosmetic procedures for users. This trend is driven by pharmaceutical advancements and growing patient bases.

title: 'Being Pullela Gopichand's daughter is a big baggage': Coach B Sumeeth Reddy
content: Player-turned-coach Sumeeth Reddy says Gayatri Gopichand's maiden World Championships medal is more than a podium finish. It's the release of years of expectation carried as the daughter of Indian badminton legend and national coach Pullela Gopichand. The team of Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly defeated China's Jia Yi Fan and Zhang Shu Xian 16-21, 21-15, 21-13 to secure at least a bronze.

content: The rise in sugar prices is being attributed to hoarding and worries about tight supplies due to a fall in sugarcane harvest due to either flooding or less rainfall in top sugarcane-producing states like Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Karnataka.

title: 2 killed after small plane crashes in Croatia
content:
Rescue teams find two dead after small plane crashes near Croatia’s Zadar

Two people were found dead late Friday after a small plane flying from the Czech Republic crashed in the mountains of Paklenica National Park, about 60 kilometres northeast of the coastal city of Zadar, news agency AP reported citing Croatian authorities said. “The search for the missing ultralight plane was concluded around 10pm when members of the Croatian Mountain Rescue Service found the plane and two dead persons," Croatian police said in a statement. Authorities have not yet disclosed the nationalities of the two people on board. Police said the crash site would be secured for an on-site investigation early Saturday to determine the circumstances of the accident. The search operation began after air traffic control raised an alarm when the aircraft’s signal was lost at around 4pm local time. Rescue teams later located the wreckage in the mountainous area.

End of Article
